copt-screening/1.formula: sum over t of w[t] x P[available capacity < residual load[t]] (two-state COPT)
copt-screening/1.validity: the residual and weights must reproduce the engine's (residual_mismatch, weights_mismatch) and each figure its headline (headline_mismatch). Refusals: copt_conventions_not_reproduced, copt_inputs_not_finite, copt_table_too_large, network_scope_required, no_copt_fleet, unsupported_snapshot_scope, unusable_outage_rate
